about: The tells on a pinnacle boss's big hits (#126), kept by hand. tools/bosstells.py writes data/bosstells.json from it and fails on a boss or hit name data/bosses.json and data/bosshits.json do not have. `hit` is the hit's name in data/bosshits.json; `name` is what the source calls the move; `tell` is what the source says shows before it lands; `src` names every source the line stands on. `why` says how the hit was matched to the source's move and is not shipped. A hit no source gives a tell for has no row. A cooldown (`cd`, seconds) only where a source states one.

The Arbiter of Ash.name: Falling Flame Seed
The Arbiter of Ash.tell: Flame seeds drop, each with a ring of fire around it. Everything outside the ring blows up a moment later. Inside the ring is safe. Before a chain of seeds he fires one flare up per seed.
The Arbiter of Ash.why: Mobalytics: the explosion is called Donut Nuke on the Arbiter's skill card; the wiki's Falling Flame Seed is the same ring and blast.

The Arbiter of Ash.name: Bullet Hell
The Arbiter of Ash.tell: Slow fire orbs float out and spray small fireballs in every direction.
The Arbiter of Ash.why: Both name the move Bullet Hell; the hit is one of the game file's three Bullet Hell skills.

The Arbiter of Ash.name: Combo Slam
The Arbiter of Ash.tell: Flies up and cuts a line of fire across the arena, then slams down three times, each one wider.
The Arbiter of Ash.why: The game file's chasm slams come short, mid and long: the wiki's three slams, each bigger, after the line of fire.

The Arbiter of Ash.name: Sword Slam
The Arbiter of Ash.tell: Leaps into the air, often with a voice line, then drives the sword down. A roll on the way down is late.
The Arbiter of Ash.why: Same name as the game file's skill.

Xesht, We That Are One.name: Xoph Sun Orb
Xesht, We That Are One.tell: An orange fire orb forms over his head and is thrown at the ground in front of him.
Xesht, We That Are One.why: His only fire move: Xoph's orb over his head, thrown at the ground.

Xesht, We That Are One.name: Finger Gun
Xesht, We That Are One.tell: Raises a hand like a pistol, with a sound cue, then flicks out a slow wave of air. It can be rolled, circled, or cut off by line of sight behind a wall. Frost Wall does not block it.
Xesht, We That Are One.why: Pistol and flick: Maxroll's Finger Gun, a flicked shot of air.

Xesht, We That Are One.name: Clap Cleave
Xesht, We That Are One.tell: Dives underground and chases you, then comes up and claps, slicing the ground to both sides. Wide circles at the arena edge stay clear until the slices are done.
Xesht, We That Are One.why: The wiki's Clap Cleave and Maxroll's Burrow: the one move that ends in a clap.

Xesht, We That Are One.name: Hand Slam
Xesht, We That Are One.tell: A giant hand hovers after you. A pink and purple hand shape marks the ground, then it slams. Its shadow shows where it is. Its side is clear; past the fingers is not. His hardest hit.
Xesht, We That Are One.why: Same name on the wiki; Maxroll calls it Hand Smash.

Vessel of Kulemak.name: Teleport Slam
Vessel of Kulemak.tell: Last phase: digs into the ground, then drops out of the sky onto an area. Since 0.3.0b it cannot be avoided.
Vessel of Kulemak.why: Same name as the game file's skill.

Vessel of Kulemak.name: Arena-wide Cleave
Vessel of Kulemak.tell: A wide strip of the arena is marked and swept by wind. A cold wave runs the way the wind and its neck point, then comes back the other way.
Vessel of Kulemak.why: The game file's Cleave, cold damage: the wiki's cold wave across the arena.

The Bodach.name: Slam
The Bodach.tell: Second phase: channels and draws a circle on the ground, then teleports into it and slams. The circle marks where it lands.
The Bodach.why: The game file marks this slam as the second phase's leap slam; Maxroll's only second-phase slam.
